Kashmiri Pandit's Restaurant Sparks Debate on Migrant Integration

A visually impaired Kashmiri Pandit, Akash Dhar, has opened a restaurant in Langate, Jammu and Kashmir. The eatery has attracted customers from various communities and areas, sparking discussions about migrant integration and the concept of 'ghar wapsi' (homecoming). The initiative aims to promote social cohesion and inspire other Kashmiri migrants to return to their homeland.
